Episode Map: Episode 1 introduces Shanmukh Jaswanth (Shannu), a calculated software engineer whose life goal is to earn dollars and settle in USA/UK with strictly zero plans for romance. Office setup (L0013-L0094): Shannu works with Marvel Manohar (die-hard Marvel fan), DC Don (DC fan), Harika (tomboy colleague), and Arvind (chill manager). Conflict/Inciting Incident (L0095-L0140): Team talks about new joinees; Shannu insists love is not in his plans. Vaishnavi joins the company as a fresher. Complications (L0141-L0365): Shannu imagines an absurdly tragic proposal, avoids asking her out, but she ends up in his team. Introductions and KT sessions lead to comic dynamics. Climax/Resolution (L0385-L0482): Shannu mistakes her asking for a number for his own; later Vaishnavi manipulates him into giving her a bike drop using his own team-leader words against him.
